name: Sizewick
subtitle: Exam Form Photo & Signature KB
shortDescription: Fit your photo and signature to the exact KB, pixels and format that exam forms ask for. Private, on your phone.
longDescription:
Photo resize 20 KB, signature resize 10 KB, passport size photo KB: Sizewick fits your photo and signature to the exact file size, pixels and format that exam forms ask for.

### Exam Presets
Pick an exam such as JEE Main, NEET UG, CUET UG, UGC NET, SSC CGL/CHSL, GATE or IBPS PO/Clerk, see the rule with its source and the date we checked it, crop with a guide, and get a file that lands inside the KB band.

### Signature From Paper
Photograph your signature on white paper and Sizewick cleans the page to dark ink on white, trims it and fits it.

### Checks and Custom Sizes
Live checks for size, KB, DPI, format and background. Custom size in px, mm, cm or inch with your own KB limit.

### Private
Everything runs on your phone: no account, no upload.

Free with 2 starting credits and short rewarded ads for more, or go ad-free with a monthly plan. Rules change every cycle: always check your own notice. Not affiliated with any exam body.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
